name.description: New name; omit to keep the current one

notes.description: Internal note, not visible to contacts; empty string clears it

optInMode.description: "double" for a confirmation email, "single" without one

pendingRedirectUrl.description: URL a contact reaches after subscribing, before confirming; empty string restores the KlickTipp page

confirmedRedirectUrl.description: URL a contact reaches after confirming; empty string restores the KlickTipp page

resendConfirmationEmail.description: Whether an already pending contact receives the confirmation email again on a repeated subscription

useForChangeEmail.description: Whether this process handles email address changes; true takes that role away from the process that holds it

deletePendingSubscribersAfterDays.description: Days after which unconfirmed contacts are deleted, one of 0, 1, 3, 7, 14; 0 keeps them

metaLabels.description: Complete list of labels; replaces the existing labels, empty array removes them all

pendingPageParameters.description: Query parameters appended to pendingRedirectUrl, by the name each is appended under; needs pendingRedirectUrl in the same call

confirmedPageParameters.description: Query parameters appended to confirmedRedirectUrl, by the name each is appended under; needs confirmedRedirectUrl in the same call

referralLinkParameterName.description: Name the referral link is appended under; only together with referralLinkId

referralLinkId.description: ID of the account's own referral-link tool, as get-opt-in-process reports it; 0 means no referral link, and then referralLinkParameterName has to be empty too

pendingUtmParameters.description: Campaign tracking values appended to pendingRedirectUrl, by query name; the value, not the name; needs pendingRedirectUrl in the same call

confirmedUtmParameters.description: The same for confirmedRedirectUrl; needs confirmedRedirectUrl in the same call

accountId.description: User ID of the account; omit for the account the access token works in

tools.name: update-signature
tools.description: Updates an email signature's name, internal note, labels or digital business card; omitted fields stay and empty business-card strings clear them. Content, tag IDs and sender profile are never changed.
tools.title: Update Email Signature

signatureId.description: ID of the signature to update

name.description: New unique name; omit to keep it, and note that the default signature cannot be renamed

notes.description: New internal note; omit to keep it, or pass an empty string to clear it

metaLabels.description: Replacement labels; omit to keep them, or pass an empty array to clear them

vCard.description: Plain-text digital-business-card fields to change; omitted fields stay unchanged and empty strings clear fields

accountId.description: User ID of the account that owns the signature; omit for the token account, or pass an accessible subaccount ID

tools.name: upload-email-editor-image-file
tools.description: Stores a user-picked JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP file in the email-editor image library and returns its public URL. Only for the MCP App upload form of open-email-editor-image-upload; maximum 5 MB and no overwrite.
tools.title: Store Picked Image File

fileName.description: Name of the picked file, as the browser reports it; sanitised, extension set from the bytes, a taken name is numbered, never overwritten -- see storedAs

contentBase64.description: The file's bytes as plain base64, no data: prefix

folder.description: Folder of the library to store it in, as list-email-editor-image-folders lists it; omit for the library's root

accountId.description: User ID of the account; omit for the account the access token works in

tools.name: upload-email-editor-image-from-url
tools.description: Uploads a public image URL into the email-editor library and returns a URL ready for an email image block. The source must be publicly reachable, not private or login-protected. Accepts JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP up to 5 MB; never overwrites.
tools.title: Add Image From URL

fileName.description: Name for the file, extension optional; sanitised, extension set from the bytes, a taken name is numbered, never overwritten -- see storedAs

sourceUrl.description: Public http(s) URL the server fetches the image from; reachable from the internet, no login, no private host

folder.description: Folder of the library to store it in, as list-email-editor-image-folders lists it; omit for the library's root

accountId.description: User ID of the account; omit for the account the access token works in

tools.name: upsert-subscribed-contact
tools.description: Creates or updates a contact, subscribing it immediately without double opt-in. Supplied field values may be overwritten and automations may start. To let an address confirm through an opt-in process, use subscribe-contact-via-opt-in-process instead.
tools.title: Create Contact

email.description: Email address of the contact; at least one of email and phoneNumber is required

phoneNumber.description: Mobile number with country code, as +49170... or 0049170...; at least one of email and phoneNumber is required

tagId.description: Manual tag to assign to the contact; omit for none

fields.description: Contact field values to write with the contact, each {fieldId, value} as get-contact and search-custom-fields name them

accountId.description: User ID of the account; omit for the account the access token works in

tools.name: validate-account-sending-readiness
tools.description: Checks account newsletter-sending readiness from stored DNS state, sender addresses, signatures, opt-in processes and contacts. Blocking findings make readyToSend false; no contacts is informational. Does not start DNS checks or evaluate billing and feature access.
tools.title: Get Account Sending Readiness

accountId.description: User ID of the account; omit for the account the access token works in

tools.name: validate-automation
tools.description: Validates a saved automation and returns action-specific findings and the checked revision. Checks the graph and settings of each action, the subject, content and publication of each email, whether each email can be sent from the address and domain it sends from (code "email sender cannot send"; an email without its own sender address sends from the account address, one with "dispatchProfile" from its signature or the account address, and a signature chosen by contact tags is checked as the default signature), and whether the tag of each condition has the type its operator takes (code "condition tag has wrong type"; the editor shows such a condition empty, rewrite it with the operator the message names). Both are warnings: activation does not check them. Does not check spam score or links. Sends and activates nothing.
tools.title: Validate Automation

tools.name: validate-email-editor-content
tools.description: Checks a stored drag-and-drop email body for content defects: empty text, incomplete blocks, missing footer placeholders, low text/link contrast (WCAG 4.5:1), and via Beefree unreachable or missing links, heavy images or HTML (Gmail clips above 102 KB) and text below 14px. Findings name the block and the fix. Does not review copy, demo text, personalisation fallbacks or layout, nor signatures, spam or sending readiness. Previous-editor emails are refused. Reads only.
tools.title: Check Email Content

emailId.description: ID of the email; omit when the editor URL is given

editorUrl.description: Editor URL of the email, as a previous read returned it; omit when the email ID is given

skipExternalCheck.description: True skips the link, weight and font-size checks that send the content to Beefree

accountId.description: User ID of the account; omit for the account the access token works in
